notes: The text is cut off after «نهى ح»: a third branch is not read and the saying is incomplete.
The first branch stops at «أبي بشر»; «ميمون بن مهران» and «ابن عباس» are written only in the second branch, so they are not extended into the first.
«قال أبو بشر أخبرنا» in the second branch: Abu Bishr speaks and is a link in that branch.
